pick.name: Figma
pick.why: Largest ecosystem, plugins and community files; designers and agencies expect Figma files.
pick.free_limits: Starter free: unlimited drafts, 150 AI credits/day up to 500/mo; Professional Full seat $16/mo (3,000 AI credits); Dev $12; Collab $3

best_free.name: Penpot
best_free.what: Open-source design tool, web or self-hosted, with MCP
best_free.why: Best free option: $0 Professional with no tool limits, open standards (SVG/CSS), self-hostable.
best_free.free_limits: Professional $0 (cloud): all design tools, unlimited files, up to 8 team members plus unlimited viewers, 10 GB storage, 7-day version history and file recovery. Unlimited $7/editor/mo (capped $175/mo, 25 GB, 30 days); Enterprise $25/member/mo; self-hosting free

alts.name: Google Stitch
alts.what: AI-native design canvas from Google Labs
alts.why: Fast screen variants; free quota unverified.

candidates.name: Penpot
candidates.verdict: best_free; very close for most solo founders

decision: Figma is the best overall for a general founder because collaborators and the plugin ecosystem default to it. Penpot is a full-featured free alternative with open licensing and no tool limits; choose it when budget, self-hosting or lock-in matter. MCP call limits are very low on Figma free plans.
details: Pick flipped from Penpot to Figma; Penpot is best_free.

os_notes.macOS: Figma desktop and web; Penpot web.
os_notes.Windows: Figma desktop and web; Penpot web.
os_notes.Linux: Both via browser (no official Figma desktop app); Penpot self-hostable.

verify.note: Starter 150 AI credits/day up to 500/mo; Professional Full $16/mo (+3,000 credits), Dev $12, Collab $3 confirmed. Figma remains the best overall because of the ecosystem and collaborator default.
